site_domain.description: Primary domain name for this AWStats configuration. Only log entries matching this domain (or aliases) will be processed.

host_aliases.description: List of hostnames (CNAMEs, subdomains, or alternate domains) to treat as equivalent to the primary domain.

timezone.description: Timezone offset in hours from UTC (e.g., -5 for EST, +1 for CET). Used to align reports with local time.

language.description: Language code for reports (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja'). Must match one of the languages installed with AWStats.
